_what: Known defects of the PRODUCTION corpus, recorded in this repository, and the safe repair for each. Applied by `npm run corpus:integrity -- apply-repairs --apply` (dry run without --apply); `npm run eval:preflight` blocks while an entry marked launchBlocker is still servable.
_rules: Every entry cites the repository record it rests on (evidence). Nothing here is a guess about the database.
An entry with sourceId touches that row only, and only if the row's title matches too; otherwise it is reported as a mismatch and nothing changes.
No entry adds legal text, a law number or a year. A damaged text is quarantined (kept, never served) until a clean official text replaces it with `corpus:integrity replace`.
set_provenance never overwrites a recorded value; Gazette verification is never set here — it needs a reviewer and a Gazette reference (`corpus:integrity gazette-verify`).
Every change is logged in corpus_integrity_events with actor 'repair-manifest:<id>'.
